title: Reuben Hughes and the Baruch family's Club Zombie
summary: Reason explains Saul Broad as the owner of the nightclub where they played.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: What did Reuben Hughes play? Alto sax. He played alto. And this guy Saul Broad.
Saul Broad was, as you know, the Jewish guy owned the nightclub where we played called Broad's Club Zombie.
Oh, I see. I just didn't know what he did.
See, not the Father and the Son owned the place together. He Broad and Saul Broad, B.A.R.U.D.
